collection.title: MG MG 6 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a MG 6 Saloon 2011 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this MG 6, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: MG MG 6 2011 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
